+def sha(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+

+def require_runtime_ready(*args, **kwargs):
+    # No flag, JSON value, environment variable or supplied receipt can open
+    # this source-only checkpoint. Wave3 owns a reviewed integration successor.
+    raise ValueError("App10/18 runtime CLOSED: profile-only source, no admitted execution adapter")
+

+def _physical_file(root, relative, maximum=2 * 1024**2):
+    root = Path(root)
+    require(root.is_absolute() and root.resolve() == root and root.is_dir(),
+            "Exact physical source/control root required")
+    path = root / relative
+    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve() == path
+            and path.is_relative_to(root) and path.stat().st_size <= maximum,
+            "Exact bounded physical input required: " + relative)
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def _profile():
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    raw = _physical_file(root, "profile.json")
+    require(sha(raw) == PROFILE_SHA256, "Fixed App10/18 profile changed")
+    value = json.loads(raw)
+    require(value["schema"] == "pinkha-app-product-delta10-closed-profile-v1"
+            and value["runtimeReady"] is False and set(value["lanes"]) == set(LANES)
+            and (value["methods"], value["declaredCases"]) == (10, 18),
+            "Finite closed App10/18 scope differs")
+    pin = value["sourceInverse"]
+    require(pin["file"] == "source-inverse.json", "Fixed inverse filename required")
+    inverse_raw = _physical_file(root, pin["file"])
+    require(len(inverse_raw) == pin["bytes"] and sha(inverse_raw) == pin["sha256"],
+            "Published finite source inverses changed")
+    inverse = json.loads(inverse_raw)
+    require(inverse["schema"] == "pinkha-app-product-delta10-source-inverse-v1"
+            and inverse["runtimeReady"] is False and inverse["swiftSourceModifiedOrCompiled"] is False
+            and set(inverse["sources"]) == {"g05", "g07", "bin"}, "Finite inverse scope differs")
+    return value, inverse
+
+
+def _originals(originals):
+    cls = type(originals)
+    module = sys.modules.get(cls.__module__)
+    require(module is not None and cls.__name__ == "Originals"
+            and getattr(module, "Originals", None) is cls, "Actual original Core22 loader object required")
+    path = Path(module.__file__)
+    require(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path and not path.is_symlink()
+            and sha(path.read_bytes()) == ORIGINALS_SHA256,
+            "Original Core22 loader source changed")
+    require(originals.proof.get("manifestSHA256") == ORIGINAL_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+            "Original 15-file Core22 closure differs")
+    for name, member in (("wave15_core_profile", "core_declarations"),
+                         ("shared_editor_existing_build", "enumeration"),
+                         ("run_host_tests", "host_results"),
+                         ("native_compiler_witness", "witness")):
+        require(originals.modules.get(name) is getattr(originals, member)
+                and sys.modules.get(name) is getattr(originals, member),
+                "Foreign or replaced original validator module: " + name)
+    originals.unchanged()
+
+
+def _reverse_source(raw, steps, source):
+    current, proofs = raw, []
+    for step in steps:
+        require(len(current) == step["candidateBytes"] and sha(current) == step["candidateSHA256"],
+                "Exact candidate input to source inverse required")
+        end = len(current)
+        for edit in reversed(step["edits"]):
+            start, length = edit["candidateOffset"], edit["candidateBytes"]
+            require(type(start) is int and type(length) is int and 0 <= start <= start + length <= end,
+                    "Overlapping or invalid finite inverse span")
+            replacement = edit["restoreUTF8"].encode("utf-8")
+            require(sha(current[start:start + length]) == edit["candidateSHA256"]
+                    and sha(replacement) == edit["restoreSHA256"], "Finite inverse preimage differs")
+            current = current[:start] + replacement + current[start + length:]
+            end = start
+        require(len(current) == step["restoredBytes"] and sha(current) == step["restoredSHA256"],
+                "Finite inverse did not restore the published original input")
+        proofs.append({key: step[key] for key in
+                       ("candidateSHA256", "candidateBytes", "restoredSHA256", "restoredBytes")})
+    require(len(current) == source["restoredOriginalBytes"]
+            and sha(current) == source["restoredOriginalSHA256"], "Original source custody differs")
+    return proofs
+
+
+def _declaration_view(raw, source_key, inverse):
+    if source_key != "g07":
+        return raw, {"projectionApplied": False, "swiftSourceModified": False}
+    spec = inverse["g07DeclarationProjection"]
+    size = spec["prefixBytes"]
+    prefix, append = raw[:size], raw[size:]
+    token = spec["annotationUTF8"].encode("utf-8")
+    offsets = spec["byteOffsets"]
+    require(sha(raw) == spec["sourceSHA256"] and size == 68698
+            and sha(prefix) == spec["prefixSHA256"] and len(append) == spec["appendBytes"] == 4608
+            and sha(append) == spec["appendSHA256"] and token == b"    @MainActor\n"
+            and append.count(token) == 2 and offsets == [68852, 70879],
+            "Only the exact published two-annotation G07 append is supported")
+    projected = raw
+    for offset in reversed(offsets):
+        require(projected[offset:offset + len(token)] == token, "Reviewed annotation position changed")
+        projected = projected[:offset] + projected[offset + len(token):]
+    require(projected[:size] == prefix and sha(projected) == spec["projectionSHA256"],
+            "Declaration-only projection changed other source bytes")
+    restored = projected
+    for offset in offsets:
+        restored = restored[:offset] + token + restored[offset:]
+    require(restored == raw, "Annotation projection inverse changed actual Swift source")
+    return projected, {"projectionApplied": True, "removedAnnotations": 2,
+                       "originalSHA256": sha(raw), "declarationViewSHA256": sha(projected),
+                       "exactInverse": True, "swiftSourceModified": False}
+

+def fixed_contract(lane):
+    """Fixed source expectations only; these are not observed compiled IDs."""
+    require(lane in HOSTED_LANES, "Only the four fixed App10/18 lanes are supported")
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    source = profile["sources"][selected["source"]]
+    suite, methods = selected["suite"], selected["methods"]
+    identifiers = sorted(TARGET + "/" + suite + "/" + name + "("
+                         + "".join(item["name"] + ":" for item in definition["parameters"]) + ")"
+                         for name, definition in methods.items())
+    return {"kind": lane, "scope": "App-product-delta10-18", "phase": "FIXED_SOURCE_EXPECTATIONS_ONLY",
+            "suite": suite, "methods": sorted(suite + "/" + name for name in methods),
+            "expected_compiled_identifiers": identifiers,
+            "expected_methods": selected["expectedMethods"], "declared_cases": selected["declaredCases"],
+            "source_hashes": {source["path"]: source["sha256"]},
+            "original_target": source["originalTarget"], "selected_target": TARGET,
+            "profile_sha256": PROFILE_SHA256, "source_commit": None, "native_compilation_proof": None,
+            "actual_native_compiler_witnesses": None, "actual_compiled_enumeration": None,
+            "product_admission_performed": False, "runtime_admission_performed": False,
+            "tests_executed": 0}
+

+def declared_contract(originals, lane):
+    """Inspect exact published source; never claim compilation or enumeration."""
+    require(lane in LANES, "Only the four fixed App10/18 lanes are supported")
+    _originals(originals)
+    profile, inverse = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    key = selected["source"]
+    source = profile["sources"][key]
+    raw = _physical_file(originals.source, source["path"])
+    require(len(raw) == source["bytes"] and sha(raw) == source["sha256"],
+            "Full published test input changed: " + source["path"])
+    restored = _reverse_source(raw, inverse["sources"][key], source)
+    view, projection = _declaration_view(raw, key, inverse)
+    complete = originals.core_declarations.inspect_declarations(view.decode("utf-8"))
+    require(complete == source["completeDeclarations"], "Complete immutable declaration inventory differs")
+    methods = selected["methods"]
+    require({name: complete[name] for name in methods} == methods
+            and len(methods) == selected["expectedMethods"]
+            and sum(value["case_count"] for value in methods.values()) == selected["declaredCases"],
+            "Selected method/literal-case inventory differs")
+    originals.unchanged()
+    return dict(fixed_contract(lane), phase="SOURCE_DECLARATIONS_ONLY",
+                complete_declarations=len(complete), source_inverse=restored,
+                declaration_projection=projection)

+def selection_plan(originals, lane):
+    """Source-derived proposed selectors, explicitly not permission to execute."""
+    contract = declared_contract(originals, lane)
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    scope = profile["lanes"][lane]["invocationScope"]
+    selectors = (contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"] if scope == "exact-methods"
+                 else [TARGET + "/" + contract["suite"]])
+    require((scope == "exact-methods") == (lane == "product-g07-drop-authority-hosted"),
+            "Legacy G07 whole-suite selection is prohibited")
+    return {"contract": contract, "proposed_invocation_selectors": selectors,
+            "source_declarations_only": True, "execution_authorized": False}

+def source_contract(originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+    """Read-only proof from a future already-admitted producer, not admission.
+
+    Wave3 must pass its actual common-admitted source commit and producer's
+    nativeCompilationProof. No source hash or source root is caller-configurable.
+    """
+    require(isinstance(source_commit, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source_commit)
+            and isinstance(native_compilation_proof, dict)
+            and isinstance(native_compilation_proof.get("path"), str)
+            and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", native_compilation_proof.get("sha256", "")),
+            "Actual admitted source/native compiler proof required; declaration evidence is insufficient")
+    contract = declared_contract(originals, lane)
+    rtl = originals.source / "Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/combined_heart_semantics/wave2/rtl-current-editor-profile/rtl_hosted_profile.py"
+    proof = originals.witness.verify_native_compiler_sources(
+        originals.source, source_commit=source_commit, native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof,
+        expected_sources=contract["source_hashes"], rtl_profile_path=rtl)
+    require(proof["source_hashes"] == contract["source_hashes"] and proof["tests_executed"] == 0
+            and proof["actual_native_compiler_witnesses"], "Exact actual native compiler witnesses required")
+    return dict(contract, phase="SOURCE_AND_COMPILER_WITNESS_QUALIFIED", source_commit=source_commit,
+                native_compilation_proof=copy.deepcopy(native_compilation_proof),
+                actual_native_compiler_witnesses=proof["actual_native_compiler_witnesses"],
+                witness_validator_sha256=proof["witness_validator_sha256"])

+def _result_evidence(originals, lane, summary, tree, udid):
+    """Pure existing evidence validators; caller still owes compiler/enumeration custody."""
+    _originals(originals)
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    suites = {selected["suite"]: {"methods": selected["methods"]}}
+    expected = {selected["suite"] + "/" + name for name in selected["methods"]}
+    observed = originals.host_results.validate_results(summary, tree, expected, udid)
+    cases = originals.core_declarations.validate_arguments(tree, expected, suites)
+    require(observed["counts"]["totalTestCount"] in {selected["expectedMethods"], selected["declaredCases"]}
+            and cases["actual_method_count"] == selected["expectedMethods"]
+            and cases["declared_case_count"] == selected["declaredCases"],
+            "Exact App delta method/argument execution is incomplete")
+    return dict(observed, **cases)

+class CompilerQualifiedProfile:
+    """One fixed lane's validators; carries no runtime permission or process API.
+
+    Keep this same instance for selection, actual enumeration and result checks.
+    A new instance cannot inherit an earlier lane's enumeration observation.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+        self.originals, self.lane = originals, lane
+        self.contract = source_contract(originals, lane, source_commit=source_commit,
+                                        native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof)
+        self.enumeration = None
+
+    def _unchanged(self):
+        before = self.contract
+        require(source_contract(self.originals, self.lane, source_commit=before["source_commit"],
+                                native_compilation_proof=before["native_compilation_proof"]) == before,
+                "Original source/compiler witness changed during this profile")
+
+    def invocation_selectors(self, selectors):
+        self._unchanged()
+        require(sorted(selectors) == self.contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"]
+                and len(selectors) == len(set(selectors)) == self.contract["expected_methods"],
+                "Only the complete exact new method selection is supported")
+        return selection_plan(self.originals, self.lane)["proposed_invocation_selectors"]
+
+    def validate_enumeration(self, payload):
+        require(self.enumeration is None, "One actual enumeration observation per lane instance required")
+        self._unchanged()
+        plan, enabled, disabled = self.originals.enumeration.enumerated_identifiers(payload)
+        require(plan == TARGET and enabled == set(self.contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"])
+                and not enabled.intersection(disabled),
+                "Actual compiled new-method selection differs; never widen to the legacy suite")
+        self.enumeration = copy.deepcopy(payload)
+        return {"test_plan": plan, "actual_compiled_identifiers": sorted(enabled),
+                "source_compiler_witness_qualified": True, "tests_executed": 0,
+                "runtime_admission_performed": False}
+
+    def validate_results(self, summary, tree, udid):
+        require(self.enumeration is not None, "Actual same-instance compiled enumeration must precede results")
+        self._unchanged()
+        result = _result_evidence(self.originals, self.lane, summary, tree, udid)
+        self._unchanged()
+        return dict(result, profile_scope="App-product-delta10-18", original_target=self.contract["original_target"],
+                    selected_target=TARGET, sourceContract=copy.deepcopy(self.contract),
+                    applicationUIAccepted=False, nativePersistenceAccepted=False, nativeACLAccepted=False,
+                    physicalDeviceAccepted=False, runtime_admission_performed=False)
+
+
+def validators(originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+    """Exact equivalent of a native_core validator factory; keep one per lane."""
+    return CompilerQualifiedProfile(originals, lane, source_commit=source_commit,
+                                    native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof)
+

+def invocation_selectors(selectors, qualified_profile):
+    """Route through the same fixed compiler-qualified validator instance."""
+    require(type(qualified_profile) is CompilerQualifiedProfile, "Actual fixed App10/18 validator instance required")
+    return qualified_profile.invocation_selectors(selectors)

+# Closed App product delta profile — 10 methods / 18 cases
+
+This is a **profile-only source tranche** for the new G05, G07 and Bin regression methods. Its runtime gate always refuses. It adds no producer, process manager, simulator command, native account, runtime output path, workflow, or application source change.
+
+The original Core22 controller and all its existing selectors, source files, execution functions, validators and lifecycle code remain unchanged. The complete published source/test handoff is App commit `2519140dd1966cedc4403b74f0f00479e9bd289f`, under `docs/validation/20261127-wave2-product-admission-delta`.
+
+## Fixed scope and source custody
+
+| Lane | Exact source suite | Original target | Hosted target | Methods / cases |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
+| `product-g05-readonly-hosted` | `PropertyPickerReadOnlyLookupTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 3 / 7 |
+| `product-g05-revision-hosted` | `PropertyPickerNativeLookupRevisionTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 3 / 6 |
+| `product-g07-drop-authority-hosted` | Two new methods in `TorahAssociationNativeRepositoryTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 2 / 2 |
+| `product-bin-read-publication-hosted` | `AnyLibraryBinPublicationTests` | PinkhaAnyUITests | AnytypeTests | 2 / 3 |
+
+`profile.json` contains the literal method/argument inventories and exact full-file hashes. The three existing compiled input paths are unchanged; their content hashes must be updated in the next actual complete producer inventory. This profile does not invent a new PBX source or accept a partial build.
+
+`source-inverse.json` restores the complete published originals using finite byte offsets and pinned preimages:
+
+- G05 `6ef0ad1e…` reverses first to the exact `6f17a932…` initial read-only tranche, then to original `1bdd1c49…`.
+- Bin `b242b8bd…` reverses to the exact original `e46dc675…` input, preserving its two search methods.
+- G07 `4a2463e6…` reverses to the original 68,698-byte `6132f482…` input. Its exact 4,608-byte append is `402e3dcd…`.
+
+The unchanged original parser reads the full 15/35/4 declaration inventories. Suite membership and selected names are fixed by the pinned whole source. G07 requires a declaration-only memory view because its two new `@MainActor` lines occur between `@Test` and `func`. Only byte offsets 68,852 and 70,879 are removed from that exact append; the inverse reconstructs every original byte. The resulting parser view is `8becc019…`. No Swift source file is written or compiled from that view. Compiler witnesses always bind the complete original `4a2463e6…` bytes.
+
+## API for Wave3's separately reviewed adapter
+
+The profile exposes the requested finite names, with an explicit equivalent context API:
+
+```python
+HOSTED_LANES
+fixed_contract(lane)
+declared_contract(originals, lane)
+selection_plan(originals, lane)
+source_contract(
+    originals, lane,
+    source_commit=actual_admitted_source_commit,
+    native_compilation_proof=actual_admitted_producer_native_proof,
+)
+validators(
+    originals, lane,
+    source_commit=actual_admitted_source_commit,
+    native_compilation_proof=actual_admitted_producer_native_proof,
+)
+invocation_selectors(expected_identifiers, qualified_profile)
+require_runtime_ready(...)  # Always raises in this source-only checkpoint.
+```
+
+`originals` must be the actual unchanged Core22 `Originals` class, loader SHA `aabcf1eec2643f331ed3ab3ae095e156c03de29c4a75ea32405819495af2c9cc`, with its original 15-file manifest SHA `81d178d6d829dc2eff201b8b8dcd190db2da79dc68a6cc06f36ca0d8a90d2778`. +"""Finite synthetic source/evidence boundaries; never Apple/runtime acceptance."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import io
+import json
+import shutil
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = ROOT.parent
+SPAWN_EVENTS = []
+
+
+def forbid_children(event, args):
+    if event in {"subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.posix_spawn", "os.fork"}:
+        SPAWN_EVENTS.append(event)
+        raise AssertionError("Portable control may not launch any child command")
+
+
+sys.addaudithook(forbid_children)
+
+
+def sha(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def module(name, path):
+    specification = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(specification)
+    sys.modules[name] = result
+    specification.loader.exec_module(result)
+    return result
+
+
+class FixedProfileControls(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="delta10-controls-", dir=ROOT)
+        cls.root = Path(cls.temporary.name)
+        cls.source = cls.root / "source"
+        cls.source.mkdir()
+        originals = WORK / "wave2-product-admission-delta/profile-feasibility/originals"
+        pins = json.loads((originals / "original_sources.json").read_text())["files"]
+        locators = json.loads((ROOT / "original-fixture-locators.json").read_text())
+        cls.original_physical_before = {}
+        for relative, pin in pins.items():
+            original_path = WORK / locators[relative]
+            raw = original_path.read_bytes()
+            assert len(raw) == pin["bytes"] and sha(raw) == pin["sha256"]
+            cls.original_physical_before[original_path] = sha(raw)
+            destination = cls.source / relative
+            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            destination.write_bytes(raw)
+        cls.swift = {
+            "g05": "torah-acceptance-prep/g05-cache-review/candidate/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/PropertyCreationSearchTests.swift",
+            "g07": "wave2-quote-audit/patch/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/TorahAssociationNativeRepositoryTests.swift",
+            "bin": "interfaces_work/bin-read-failure/candidate/Modules/PinkhaAnyUI/Tests/PinkhaAnyUITests/AnyLibrarySearchPublicationTests.swift",
+        }
+        cls.profile_spec = json.loads((ROOT / "profile/profile.json").read_text())
+        for key, relative in cls.swift.items():
+            raw = (WORK / relative).read_bytes()
+            specification = cls.profile_spec["sources"][key]
+            assert sha(raw) == specification["sha256"]
+            destination = cls.source / specification["path"]
+            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            destination.write_bytes(raw)
+        control = cls.root / "original-control"
+        control.mkdir()
+        for name in ("originals.py", "original_sources.json"):
+            shutil.copyfile(originals / name, control / name)
+        original_module = module("delta10_exact_core22_loader", control / "originals.py")
+        cls.originals = original_module.Originals(cls.source)
+        cls.originals.install()
+        cls.profile_root = cls.root / "profile"
+        shutil.copytree(ROOT / "profile", cls.profile_root)
+        cls.profile = module("delta10_closed_profile_under_test", cls.profile_root / "profile.py")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        try:
+            cls.originals.unchanged()
+            assert all(sha(path.read_bytes()) == value for path, value in cls.original_physical_before.items())
+        finally:
+            cls.originals.close()
+            cls.temporary.cleanup()

+    def test_exact_full_sources_preserve_old_scopes_and_select_only_new_ten(self):
+        contracts = [self.profile.declared_contract(self.originals, lane) for lane in self.profile.LANES]
+        self.assertEqual(sum(value["expected_methods"] for value in contracts), 10)
+        self.assertEqual(sum(value["declared_cases"] for value in contracts), 18)
+        self.assertEqual([value["complete_declarations"] for value in contracts], [15, 15, 35, 4])
+        self.assertEqual([value["original_target"] for value in contracts],
+                         ["AnytypeTests", "AnytypeTests", "AnytypeTests", "PinkhaAnyUITests"])
+        self.assertEqual([len(value["source_inverse"]) for value in contracts], [2, 2, 1, 1])
+        for value in contracts:

+            self.assertIsNone(value["actual_compiled_enumeration"])
+            self.assertFalse(value["runtime_admission_performed"])

+    def test_old_prefix_tamper_is_rejected_even_when_new_methods_are_unchanged(self):
+        for key, lane in (("g05", self.profile.LANES[0]), ("g07", self.profile.LANES[2]), ("bin", self.profile.LANES[3])):

+    def test_inverse_and_original_validator_custody_cannot_be_bypassed(self):

+The original Core22 controller and all its existing selectors, source files, execution functions, validators and lifecycle code remain unchanged. +                      "restoreUTF8": replacement.decode(), "restoreSHA256": sha(replacement)})

+"""Four fixed App regression profiles; no runtime adapter or execution authority.
+
+The actual Core22 Originals object supplies the byte-pinned original parser,
+compiler witness, enumeration and result functions. This module never creates
+a process, descriptor, simulator, native account, or producer admission.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sys
+
+PROFILE_SHA256 = "99f81462cf589865af3224090215ab4ebf8e0c7275932f5b93629d1247b7daa8"
+ORIGINALS_SHA256 = "aabcf1eec2643f331ed3ab3ae095e156c03de29c4a75ea32405819495af2c9cc"
+ORIGINAL_MANIFEST_SHA256 = "81d178d6d829dc2eff201b8b8dcd190db2da79dc68a6cc06f36ca0d8a90d2778"
+TARGET = "AnytypeTests"
+LANES = (
+    "product-g05-readonly-hosted", "product-g05-revision-hosted",
+    "product-g07-drop-authority-hosted", "product-bin-read-publication-hosted",
+)
+HOSTED_LANES = frozenset(LANES)
+
+
+def require(value, reason):
+    if not value:
+        raise ValueError(reason)
+
+
+def sha(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def require_runtime_ready(*args, **kwargs):
+    # No flag, JSON value, environment variable or supplied receipt can open
+    # this source-only checkpoint. Wave3 owns a reviewed integration successor.
+    raise ValueError("App10/18 runtime CLOSED: profile-only source, no admitted execution adapter")
+
+
+def _physical_file(root, relative, maximum=2 * 1024**2):
+    root = Path(root)
+    require(root.is_absolute() and root.resolve() == root and root.is_dir(),
+            "Exact physical source/control root required")
+    path = root / relative
+    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve() == path
+            and path.is_relative_to(root) and path.stat().st_size <= maximum,
+            "Exact bounded physical input required: " + relative)
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def _profile():
+    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+    raw = _physical_file(root, "profile.json")
+    require(sha(raw) == PROFILE_SHA256, "Fixed App10/18 profile changed")
+    value = json.loads(raw)
+    require(value["schema"] == "pinkha-app-product-delta10-closed-profile-v1"
+            and value["runtimeReady"] is False and set(value["lanes"]) == set(LANES)
+            and (value["methods"], value["declaredCases"]) == (10, 18),
+            "Finite closed App10/18 scope differs")
+    pin = value["sourceInverse"]
+    require(pin["file"] == "source-inverse.json", "Fixed inverse filename required")
+    inverse_raw = _physical_file(root, pin["file"])
+    require(len(inverse_raw) == pin["bytes"] and sha(inverse_raw) == pin["sha256"],
+            "Published finite source inverses changed")
+    inverse = json.loads(inverse_raw)
+    require(inverse["schema"] == "pinkha-app-product-delta10-source-inverse-v1"
+            and inverse["runtimeReady"] is False and inverse["swiftSourceModifiedOrCompiled"] is False
+            and set(inverse["sources"]) == {"g05", "g07", "bin"}, "Finite inverse scope differs")
+    return value, inverse
+
+
+def _originals(originals):
+    cls = type(originals)
+    module = sys.modules.get(cls.__module__)
+    require(module is not None and cls.__name__ == "Originals"
+            and getattr(module, "Originals", None) is cls, "Actual original Core22 loader object required")
+    path = Path(module.__file__)
+    require(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve() == path and not path.is_symlink()
+            and sha(path.read_bytes()) == ORIGINALS_SHA256,
+            "Original Core22 loader source changed")
+    require(originals.proof.get("manifestSHA256") == ORIGINAL_MANIFEST_SHA256,
+            "Original 15-file Core22 closure differs")
+    for name, member in (("wave15_core_profile", "core_declarations"),
+                         ("shared_editor_existing_build", "enumeration"),
+                         ("run_host_tests", "host_results"),
+                         ("native_compiler_witness", "witness")):
+        require(originals.modules.get(name) is getattr(originals, member)
+                and sys.modules.get(name) is getattr(originals, member),
+                "Foreign or replaced original validator module: " + name)
+    originals.unchanged()
+
+
+def _reverse_source(raw, steps, source):
+    current, proofs = raw, []
+    for step in steps:
+        require(len(current) == step["candidateBytes"] and sha(current) == step["candidateSHA256"],
+                "Exact candidate input to source inverse required")
+        end = len(current)
+        for edit in reversed(step["edits"]):
+            start, length = edit["candidateOffset"], edit["candidateBytes"]
+            require(type(start) is int and type(length) is int and 0 <= start <= start + length <= end,
+                    "Overlapping or invalid finite inverse span")
+            replacement = edit["restoreUTF8"].encode("utf-8")
+            require(sha(current[start:start + length]) == edit["candidateSHA256"]
+                    and sha(replacement) == edit["restoreSHA256"], "Finite inverse preimage differs")
+            current = current[:start] + replacement + current[start + length:]
+            end = start
+        require(len(current) == step["restoredBytes"] and sha(current) == step["restoredSHA256"],
+                "Finite inverse did not restore the published original input")
+        proofs.append({key: step[key] for key in
+                       ("candidateSHA256", "candidateBytes", "restoredSHA256", "restoredBytes")})
+    require(len(current) == source["restoredOriginalBytes"]
+            and sha(current) == source["restoredOriginalSHA256"], "Original source custody differs")
+    return proofs
+
+
+def _declaration_view(raw, source_key, inverse):
+    if source_key != "g07":
+        return raw, {"projectionApplied": False, "swiftSourceModified": False}
+    spec = inverse["g07DeclarationProjection"]
+    size = spec["prefixBytes"]
+    prefix, append = raw[:size], raw[size:]
+    token = spec["annotationUTF8"].encode("utf-8")
+    offsets = spec["byteOffsets"]
+    require(sha(raw) == spec["sourceSHA256"] and size == 68698
+            and sha(prefix) == spec["prefixSHA256"] and len(append) == spec["appendBytes"] == 4608
+            and sha(append) == spec["appendSHA256"] and token == b"    @MainActor\n"
+            and append.count(token) == 2 and offsets == [68852, 70879],
+            "Only the exact published two-annotation G07 append is supported")
+    projected = raw
+    for offset in reversed(offsets):
+        require(projected[offset:offset + len(token)] == token, "Reviewed annotation position changed")
+        projected = projected[:offset] + projected[offset + len(token):]
+    require(projected[:size] == prefix and sha(projected) == spec["projectionSHA256"],
+            "Declaration-only projection changed other source bytes")
+    restored = projected
+    for offset in offsets:
+        restored = restored[:offset] + token + restored[offset:]
+    require(restored == raw, "Annotation projection inverse changed actual Swift source")
+    return projected, {"projectionApplied": True, "removedAnnotations": 2,
+                       "originalSHA256": sha(raw), "declarationViewSHA256": sha(projected),
+                       "exactInverse": True, "swiftSourceModified": False}
+
+
+def fixed_contract(lane):
+    """Fixed source expectations only; these are not observed compiled IDs."""
+    require(lane in HOSTED_LANES, "Only the four fixed App10/18 lanes are supported")
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    source = profile["sources"][selected["source"]]
+    suite, methods = selected["suite"], selected["methods"]
+    identifiers = sorted(TARGET + "/" + suite + "/" + name + "("
+                         + "".join(item["name"] + ":" for item in definition["parameters"]) + ")"
+                         for name, definition in methods.items())
+    return {"kind": lane, "scope": "App-product-delta10-18", "phase": "FIXED_SOURCE_EXPECTATIONS_ONLY",
+            "suite": suite, "methods": sorted(suite + "/" + name for name in methods),
+            "expected_compiled_identifiers": identifiers,
+            "expected_methods": selected["expectedMethods"], "declared_cases": selected["declaredCases"],
+            "source_hashes": {source["path"]: source["sha256"]},
+            "original_target": source["originalTarget"], "selected_target": TARGET,
+            "profile_sha256": PROFILE_SHA256, "source_commit": None, "native_compilation_proof": None,
+            "actual_native_compiler_witnesses": None, "actual_compiled_enumeration": None,
+            "product_admission_performed": False, "runtime_admission_performed": False,
+            "tests_executed": 0}
+
+
+def declared_contract(originals, lane):
+    """Inspect exact published source; never claim compilation or enumeration."""
+    require(lane in LANES, "Only the four fixed App10/18 lanes are supported")
+    _originals(originals)
+    profile, inverse = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    key = selected["source"]
+    source = profile["sources"][key]
+    raw = _physical_file(originals.source, source["path"])
+    require(len(raw) == source["bytes"] and sha(raw) == source["sha256"],
+            "Full published test input changed: " + source["path"])
+    restored = _reverse_source(raw, inverse["sources"][key], source)
+    view, projection = _declaration_view(raw, key, inverse)
+    complete = originals.core_declarations.inspect_declarations(view.decode("utf-8"))
+    require(complete == source["completeDeclarations"], "Complete immutable declaration inventory differs")
+    methods = selected["methods"]
+    require({name: complete[name] for name in methods} == methods
+            and len(methods) == selected["expectedMethods"]
+            and sum(value["case_count"] for value in methods.values()) == selected["declaredCases"],
+            "Selected method/literal-case inventory differs")
+    originals.unchanged()
+    return dict(fixed_contract(lane), phase="SOURCE_DECLARATIONS_ONLY",
+                complete_declarations=len(complete), source_inverse=restored,
+                declaration_projection=projection)
+
+
+def selection_plan(originals, lane):
+    """Source-derived proposed selectors, explicitly not permission to execute."""
+    contract = declared_contract(originals, lane)
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    scope = profile["lanes"][lane]["invocationScope"]
+    selectors = (contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"] if scope == "exact-methods"
+                 else [TARGET + "/" + contract["suite"]])
+    require((scope == "exact-methods") == (lane == "product-g07-drop-authority-hosted"),
+            "Legacy G07 whole-suite selection is prohibited")
+    return {"contract": contract, "proposed_invocation_selectors": selectors,
+            "source_declarations_only": True, "execution_authorized": False}
+
+
+def source_contract(originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+    """Read-only proof from a future already-admitted producer, not admission.
+
+    Wave3 must pass its actual common-admitted source commit and producer's
+    nativeCompilationProof. No source hash or source root is caller-configurable.
+    """
+    require(isinstance(source_commit, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source_commit)
+            and isinstance(native_compilation_proof, dict)
+            and isinstance(native_compilation_proof.get("path"), str)
+            and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", native_compilation_proof.get("sha256", "")),
+            "Actual admitted source/native compiler proof required; declaration evidence is insufficient")
+    contract = declared_contract(originals, lane)
+    rtl = originals.source / "Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/combined_heart_semantics/wave2/rtl-current-editor-profile/rtl_hosted_profile.py"
+    proof = originals.witness.verify_native_compiler_sources(
+        originals.source, source_commit=source_commit, native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof,
+        expected_sources=contract["source_hashes"], rtl_profile_path=rtl)
+    require(proof["source_hashes"] == contract["source_hashes"] and proof["tests_executed"] == 0
+            and proof["actual_native_compiler_witnesses"], "Exact actual native compiler witnesses required")
+    return dict(contract, phase="SOURCE_AND_COMPILER_WITNESS_QUALIFIED", source_commit=source_commit,
+                native_compilation_proof=copy.deepcopy(native_compilation_proof),
+                actual_native_compiler_witnesses=proof["actual_native_compiler_witnesses"],
+                witness_validator_sha256=proof["witness_validator_sha256"])
+
+
+def _result_evidence(originals, lane, summary, tree, udid):
+    """Pure existing evidence validators; caller still owes compiler/enumeration custody."""
+    _originals(originals)
+    profile, _ = _profile()
+    selected = profile["lanes"][lane]
+    suites = {selected["suite"]: {"methods": selected["methods"]}}
+    expected = {selected["suite"] + "/" + name for name in selected["methods"]}
+    observed = originals.host_results.validate_results(summary, tree, expected, udid)
+    cases = originals.core_declarations.validate_arguments(tree, expected, suites)
+    require(observed["counts"]["totalTestCount"] in {selected["expectedMethods"], selected["declaredCases"]}
+            and cases["actual_method_count"] == selected["expectedMethods"]
+            and cases["declared_case_count"] == selected["declaredCases"],
+            "Exact App delta method/argument execution is incomplete")
+    return dict(observed, **cases)
+
+
+class CompilerQualifiedProfile:
+    """One fixed lane's validators; carries no runtime permission or process API.
+
+    Keep this same instance for selection, actual enumeration and result checks.
+    A new instance cannot inherit an earlier lane's enumeration observation.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+        self.originals, self.lane = originals, lane
+        self.contract = source_contract(originals, lane, source_commit=source_commit,
+                                        native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof)
+        self.enumeration = None
+
+    def _unchanged(self):
+        before = self.contract
+        require(source_contract(self.originals, self.lane, source_commit=before["source_commit"],
+                                native_compilation_proof=before["native_compilation_proof"]) == before,
+                "Original source/compiler witness changed during this profile")
+
+    def invocation_selectors(self, selectors):
+        self._unchanged()
+        require(sorted(selectors) == self.contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"]
+                and len(selectors) == len(set(selectors)) == self.contract["expected_methods"],
+                "Only the complete exact new method selection is supported")
+        return selection_plan(self.originals, self.lane)["proposed_invocation_selectors"]
+
+    def validate_enumeration(self, payload):
+        require(self.enumeration is None, "One actual enumeration observation per lane instance required")
+        self._unchanged()
+        plan, enabled, disabled = self.originals.enumeration.enumerated_identifiers(payload)
+        require(plan == TARGET and enabled == set(self.contract["expected_compiled_identifiers"])
+                and not enabled.intersection(disabled),
+                "Actual compiled new-method selection differs; never widen to the legacy suite")
+        self.enumeration = copy.deepcopy(payload)
+        return {"test_plan": plan, "actual_compiled_identifiers": sorted(enabled),
+                "source_compiler_witness_qualified": True, "tests_executed": 0,
+                "runtime_admission_performed": False}
+
+    def validate_results(self, summary, tree, udid):
+        require(self.enumeration is not None, "Actual same-instance compiled enumeration must precede results")
+        self._unchanged()
+        result = _result_evidence(self.originals, self.lane, summary, tree, udid)
+        self._unchanged()
+        return dict(result, profile_scope="App-product-delta10-18", original_target=self.contract["original_target"],
+                    selected_target=TARGET, sourceContract=copy.deepcopy(self.contract),
+                    applicationUIAccepted=False, nativePersistenceAccepted=False, nativeACLAccepted=False,
+                    physicalDeviceAccepted=False, runtime_admission_performed=False)
+
+
+def validators(originals, lane, *, source_commit, native_compilation_proof):
+    """Exact equivalent of a native_core validator factory; keep one per lane."""
+    return CompilerQualifiedProfile(originals, lane, source_commit=source_commit,
+                                    native_compilation_proof=native_compilation_proof)
+
+
+def invocation_selectors(selectors, qualified_profile):
+    """Route through the same fixed compiler-qualified validator instance."""
+    require(type(qualified_profile) is CompilerQualifiedProfile, "Actual fixed App10/18 validator instance required")
+    return qualified_profile.invocation_selectors(selectors)
+
+

+# Closed App product delta profile — 10 methods / 18 cases
+
+This is a **profile-only source tranche** for the new G05, G07 and Bin regression methods. Its runtime gate always refuses. It adds no producer, process manager, simulator command, native account, runtime output path, workflow, or application source change.
+
+The original Core22 controller and all its existing selectors, source files, execution functions, validators and lifecycle code remain unchanged. The complete published source/test handoff is App commit `2519140dd1966cedc4403b74f0f00479e9bd289f`, under `docs/validation/20261127-wave2-product-admission-delta`.
+
+## Fixed scope and source custody
+
+| Lane | Exact source suite | Original target | Hosted target | Methods / cases |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
+| `product-g05-readonly-hosted` | `PropertyPickerReadOnlyLookupTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 3 / 7 |
+| `product-g05-revision-hosted` | `PropertyPickerNativeLookupRevisionTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 3 / 6 |
+| `product-g07-drop-authority-hosted` | Two new methods in `TorahAssociationNativeRepositoryTests` | AnytypeTests | AnytypeTests | 2 / 2 |

+"""Finite synthetic source/evidence boundaries; never Apple/runtime acceptance."""
+from pathlib import Path

+import sys
+import tempfile

+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = ROOT.parent
+SPAWN_EVENTS = []
+
+
+def forbid_children(event, args):
+    if event in {"subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.posix_spawn", "os.fork"}:
+        SPAWN_EVENTS.append(event)
+        raise AssertionError("Portable control may not launch any child command")

+
+sys.addaudithook(forbid_children)
+
+
+def sha(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def module(name, path):
+    specification = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
+    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(specification)
+    sys.modules[name] = result
+    specification.loader.exec_module(result)
+    return result

+class FixedProfileControls(unittest.TestCase):

+            destination = cls.source / specification["path"]

+            destination.write_bytes(raw)

+"""Local source-only preparation; creates no runtime adapter or test process."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import difflib
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+
+sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+WORK = ROOT.parent
+
+
+def sha(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def read(relative, expected):
+    value = (WORK / relative).read_bytes()
+    assert sha(value) == expected
+    return value
+
+
+def inverse(original, candidate):
+    # Finite byte offsets, including Unicode. No character-offset ambiguity.
+    old, new = original.splitlines(keepends=True), candidate.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    edits = []
+    for tag, a, b, c, d in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old, new, autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
+        if tag == "equal":
+            continue
+        replacement, expected = b"".join(old[a:b]), b"".join(new[c:d])
+        edits.append({"candidateOffset": len(b"".join(new[:c])),
+                      "candidateBytes": len(expected), "candidateSHA256": sha(expected),
+                      "restoreUTF8": replacement.decode(), "restoreSHA256": sha(replacement)})
+    restored = candidate
+    for edit in reversed(edits):
+        start, length = edit["candidateOffset"], edit["candidateBytes"]
+        assert sha(restored[start:start + length]) == edit["candidateSHA256"]
+        restored = restored[:start] + edit["restoreUTF8"].encode() + restored[start + length:]
+    assert restored == original
+    return {"candidateSHA256": sha(candidate), "candidateBytes": len(candidate),
+            "restoredSHA256": sha(original), "restoredBytes": len(original), "edits": edits}
+
+
+proposal = json.loads((WORK / "wave2-product-admission-delta/profile-feasibility/closed-profile-proposal.json").read_text())
+specs = proposal["sources"]
+raw = {
+    "g05": read("torah-acceptance-prep/g05-cache-review/candidate/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/PropertyCreationSearchTests.swift", specs["g05"]["sha256"]),
+    "g07": read("wave2-quote-audit/patch/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/TorahAssociationNativeRepositoryTests.swift", specs["g07"]["sha256"]),
+    "bin": read("interfaces_work/bin-read-failure/candidate/Modules/PinkhaAnyUI/Tests/PinkhaAnyUITests/AnyLibrarySearchPublicationTests.swift", specs["bin"]["sha256"]),
+}
+old = {
+    "g05": read("torah-acceptance-prep/g05-current-review/source/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/PropertyCreationSearchTests.swift", specs["g05"]["originalPreG05SHA256"]),
+    "g07": read("wave2-quote-audit/source/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/TorahAssociationNativeRepositoryTests.swift", specs["g07"]["retainedPrefixSHA256"]),
+    "bin": read("interfaces_work/bin-read-failure/source/Modules/PinkhaAnyUI/Tests/PinkhaAnyUITests/AnyLibrarySearchPublicationTests.swift", specs["bin"]["retainedSearchSHA256"]),
+}
+readonly = read("torah-acceptance-prep/g05-current-review/candidate/AnyTypeTests/Pinkha/PropertyCreationSearchTests.swift", specs["g05"]["retainedReadonlyPrefixSHA256"])
+inverses = {
+    "g05": [inverse(readonly, raw["g05"]), inverse(old["g05"], readonly)],
+    "g07": [inverse(old["g07"], raw["g07"])],
+    "bin": [inverse(old["bin"], raw["bin"])],
+}
+annotation = b"    @MainActor\n"
+append = raw["g07"][68698:]
+assert sha(append) == specs["g07"]["appendSHA256"] and append.count(annotation) == 2
+offsets, cursor = [], 0
+while True:
+    offset = append.find(annotation, cursor)
+    if offset < 0:
+        break
+    offsets.append(68698 + offset)
+    cursor = offset + len(annotation)
+projection = raw["g07"]
+for offset in reversed(offsets):
+    assert projection[offset:offset + len(annotation)] == annotation
+    projection = projection[:offset] + projection[offset + len(annotation):]
+inverse_document = {"schema": "pinkha-app-product-delta10-source-inverse-v1",
+                    "runtimeReady": False, "swiftSourceModifiedOrCompiled": False,
+                    "sources": inverses,
+                    "g07DeclarationProjection": {"sourceSHA256": sha(raw["g07"]),
+                        "prefixBytes": 68698, "prefixSHA256": sha(old["g07"]),
+                        "appendBytes": len(append), "appendSHA256": sha(append),
+                        "annotationUTF8": annotation.decode(), "byteOffsets": offsets,
+                        "projectionSHA256": sha(projection)}}
